posts.title: November 21st
posts.description: We report: as always during the rainier months, it is the humidity that has us shivering in the mornings. It only takes a few minutes of brisk walking for the chill to evaporate. The clouds seem to stick around for now, even while they let the sunshine through.

posts.title: November 20th
posts.description: We report: it is sunny, has been sunny since morning, but it has felt precarious all day long. It is windy by the coast, and there are many clouds, high enough in the sky that they block the sun for minutes at a time. We watch the shadows that they cast on the surface of the sea.

posts.title: November 19th
posts.description: We report: today, we had it all. There was rain, sunshine, wind, and then it started all over again. In the end, we counted four rainbows - six, if we count the double rainbows separately. At sunset, it keeps going. We also have all the colours, and it is still rainy and windy.
